hint: Hover or tap a row or a profile.

parts.title: Models
parts.body: Chosen for each run, in any deployment. Every model plugs into the same inference models port, so the same model can run under any profile.

parts.title: ROBIN core
parts.body: The same run manager, inference engine and shared contracts in every deployment. Only the adapters change.

parts.title: Catalog row
parts.body: Each deployment finds its recordings its own way: the SoundHub API through soundhub-robin, a CSV list, or recorder-card folders.

parts.title: Storage row
parts.body: The same storage port reads from an S3 bucket, a mounted lab server, or a partner's own disks.

parts.title: Compute row
parts.body: Work runs as SageMaker jobs, on a campus Slurm cluster, or on a partner's own computers.

parts.title: Governance row
parts.body: A shared provenance service, simple stamps beside the outputs, or a registry that applies the partner's own terms.

parts.title: Database row
parts.body: Always PostgreSQL. Only where it lives changes: Amazon RDS, or Docker on a lab server or partner computer.

parts.title: CDFW with SoundHub
parts.body: The profile in use today. People work in the SoundHub web app, which calls ROBIN's API; operators also use the CLI. Everything runs on AWS.

parts.title: University lab
parts.body: A lab that keeps recordings on its own server and runs work on the campus cluster, driven from the CLI.

parts.title: Indigenous partner
parts.body: Everything stays on the partner's own disks and computers, and their registry decides what each use may do.
